app_type.description: The type of voice app being created.

play_menu.description: A flag that indicates if the interactive voice menu function(receive digits from callers to take actions) is active or not.

name.description: The name of the voice app

voice.description: The set of pre-recorded voice prompts for the voice app

play_welcome.description: A flag that indicates if the welcome message is played or not.

get_extension.description: A flag that indicates if the auto-attendant function is active.

final_action.description:
The final action that is taken in case the menu (represented by `play_menu`) is not active.

This property can only be set if `play_menu` is set to `no`.

action.description: The final action to take once the caller has heard the welcome message.

to.description: The destination type where the call should be connected. For example, user.

id.description: A unique ID to identify the destination. For example, if the `to` field is user then `id` will be the user's unique ID.

menu.description: The voice response menu that defines the digits and the actions taken on each digit press

digit_0.description: Action to be taken when the caller selects option 0 in the IVR.

action.description: Action to take when the menu item is selected by the caller.

to.description: The destination type where the call should be connected. For example, user.

id.description: A unique ID to identify the destination. For example, if the `to` field is user then `id` will be the user's unique ID.

error_voice.description: The voice that applies for playing system messages. This field applies in case the app_type is `sysprompt`.

greeting_prompt.description: A flag that indicates if a greeting message is played when a caller reaches the voicemail. This field applies in case the app_type is `mailbox`

goodbye_prompt.description: A flag that indicates if a goodbye message is played when a caller has left a voicemail message. This field applies in case the app_type is `mailbox`.

deliver_to.description:
Voicemails are delivered as email attachments. This field can specify either a user or an email address to which the voicemail are delivered. This can take values `user` or `email`.

This field applies in case the app_type is `mailbox`.

deliver_to_details.description:
If `deliver_to` is a user, this field takes the user_id of the user. The email is delivered to the email address of the user configured in the Sonetel account.
If `deliver_to` is an email, this field takes the email address to which the voicemail is delivered.
